tooltip.arcforge.upgrade.energy: Cuts FE per operation to 0.8x each (Combustion Plant: +12.5% FE per fuel)
tooltip.arcforge.upgrade.heat: +12.5% heat per fuel or lava each (Thermoelectric Plant: better efficiency)

gui.arcforge.induction_array.power_hint: %s%% less FE per item than an Induction Furnace

tooltip.arcforge.upgrade.insulation: Cuts a Heat Cell's heat leak to 0.8x each
tooltip.arcforge.info.geothermal_plant: Makes heat from lava in its tank and from lava and magma touching it. The hottest heat source, up to 1,400°C.
tooltip.arcforge.info.combustion_plant: Burns coal and charcoal straight into FE. Quick to set up, but a Firebox feeding a Thermoelectric Plant gets more from each coal.
tooltip.arcforge.info.firebox: Burns coal and charcoal into heat (HU), up to 1,100°C. Push the heat into machines with Thermodynamic Conduits.
tooltip.arcforge.info.fuel_burner: Burns creosote from its tank into heat, up to 1,200°C.
tooltip.arcforge.info.thermoelectric_pla: Turns heat into FE. The hotter the heat it gets, the more FE it makes from each HU.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steam_boiler: Boils water into steam with heat. The hotter it runs, the better the steam: plain, High-Pressure or Superheated.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steam_turbine: Turns steam into FE. Better grades of steam give more FE per mB.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steam_boiler_array: Build a hollow 3x3 tower, 3 to 7 blocks tall, from these and Pressure Glass to make a big Steam Boiler.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steam_turbine_arra: Build a hollow 3x3 tube, 3 to 9 blocks long, from these and Pressure Glass to make a big Steam Turbine.
tooltip.arcforge.info.pressure_glass: Windows for the Steam Boiler and Turbine Arrays: shows the water, steam or rotor inside. Any block but the corners can be glass.
tooltip.arcforge.info.electric_pump: Pumps the fluid source below it with FE and pushes it out of its top. Leaves infinite water pools in place.
tooltip.arcforge.info.arc_crusher: Crushes ores into dusts with FE, with a chance of a bonus output. Raw ores give extra dust.
tooltip.arcforge.info.arc_crushing_array: Build a solid 3x3x3 cube from these for a three-lane crusher that doubles ores.
tooltip.arcforge.info.induction_furnace: Smelts anything a furnace can, faster, with FE.
tooltip.arcforge.info.induction_furnace_: Build a solid 3x3x3 cube from these for a three-lane Induction Furnace.
tooltip.arcforge.info.metal_press: Presses ingots into plates, gears and rods with FE. The die in its die slot decides what it makes.
tooltip.arcforge.info.metal_pressing_arr: Build a solid 3x3x3 cube from these for a three-lane Metal Press, each lane with its own die.
tooltip.arcforge.info.fiberizer: Spins slag and basalt into mineral wool with FE and heat. Needs 800°C or hotter.
tooltip.arcforge.info.infuser: Soaks wood in creosote to make treated wood, using FE.
tooltip.arcforge.info.carbonizer: Build a hollow chamber of these to bake coal into coal coke, giving creosote as a by-product.
tooltip.arcforge.info.arcforge_furnace_b: Walls of the Arcforge Furnace, the multiblock that smelts steel.
A decorative wall of Arcforge Furnace bricks.
tooltip.arcforge.info.arcforge_furnace_p: The front of the Arcforge Furnace: opens its GUI and takes items in and out.
tooltip.arcforge.info.energy_conduit: Carries FE between machines. Right-click a side with a Wrench to set it to input, output or off.
tooltip.arcforge.info.item_conduit: Carries items between inventories. Right-click a side with a Wrench to set it to input, output or off.
tooltip.arcforge.info.fluid_conduit: Carries liquids (not gases) between tanks and machines. Holds one fluid at a time.
tooltip.arcforge.info.pressurized_condui: Carries gases like steam. Glows while gas is moving. Holds one gas at a time.
tooltip.arcforge.info.thermal_conduit: Carries heat (HU) from hot machines to cooler ones.
tooltip.arcforge.info.fluid_tank: Stores one liquid. Keeps its contents when picked up with a Wrench. Stacked tanks drain downwards.
tooltip.arcforge.info.pressurized_cylind: Stores one gas, like steam. Keeps its gas when broken; the gauge shows how full it is.
tooltip.arcforge.info.energy_cell: Stores FE. Keeps its charge when broken.
tooltip.arcforge.info.heat_cell: Stores heat (HU). Leaks slowly; better tiers and Insulation Upgrades leak less.
tooltip.arcforge.info.wrench: Configures conduit sides and machines. Sneak-use to pick a machine up with its contents.
tooltip.arcforge.info.speed_upgrade: Makes a machine work faster, using power or fuel just as much faster.
tooltip.arcforge.info.energy_upgrade: Cuts the FE a machine uses per operation.
tooltip.arcforge.info.heat_upgrade: Gets more heat from each fuel, or more FE from each HU.
tooltip.arcforge.info.insulation_upgrade: Slows how fast a Heat Cell leaks heat.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steel_ingot: Made in the Arcforge Furnace from iron and coal coke. The backbone of Arcforge machines.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steel_block: Nine steel ingots in a block.
tooltip.arcforge.info.coal_coke: Coal baked in a Carbonizer. Fuel for the Arcforge Furnace, and burns longer than coal.
tooltip.arcforge.info.coal_coke_block: Nine coal coke in a block. The Arcforge Furnace breaks it back open as fuel.
tooltip.arcforge.info.slag: A by-product of making steel. Spin it into Slag Wool in a Fiberizer.
tooltip.arcforge.info.creosote_bucket: The Carbonizer's oily by-product. Treats wood in the Infuser and burns in the Fuel Burner.
tooltip.arcforge.info.iron_dust: Crushed iron. Smelts into an iron ingot.
tooltip.arcforge.info.copper_dust: Crushed copper. Smelts into a copper ingot.
tooltip.arcforge.info.gold_dust: Crushed gold. Smelts into a gold ingot.
tooltip.arcforge.info.ancient_debris_dus: Crushed ancient debris. Smelts into netherite scrap.
tooltip.arcforge.info.carbon_dust: Crushed coal or charcoal. A furnace fuel worth half a coal.
tooltip.arcforge.info.nether_quartz_dust: Crushed nether quartz. Smelts back into quartz.
tooltip.arcforge.info.slag_wool: Mineral wool spun from slag. Insulates the lower Heat Cell tiers.
tooltip.arcforge.info.rock_wool: Mineral wool spun from basalt. Insulates the better Heat Cells and makes Insulation Upgrades.
tooltip.arcforge.info.plate_die: Goes in a Metal Press die slot to press plates. Never used up.
tooltip.arcforge.info.gear_die: Goes in a Metal Press die slot to press gears. Never used up.
tooltip.arcforge.info.rod_die: Goes in a Metal Press die slot to press rods. Never used up.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steel_plate: A pressed steel plate. Used in upgrades, steam machines and the bigger arrays.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steel_gear: A pressed steel gear. Used in turbines and moving machines.
tooltip.arcforge.info.steel_rod: A pressed steel rod. Used in frames and Pressure Glass.
tooltip.arcforge.info.copper_plate: A pressed copper plate. Used in Energy Upgrades and boilers.
tooltip.arcforge.info.copper_gear: A pressed copper gear. Used in the Electric Pump.
tooltip.arcforge.info.copper_rod: A pressed copper rod. Used in Pressurized Conduits and turbines.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_log: Wood soaked in creosote. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_wood: Wood soaked in creosote. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.stripped_treated_l: Treated wood with the bark stripped off. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.stripped_treated_w: Treated wood with the bark stripped off. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_planks: Planks of creosote-treated wood. Never catch fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_stairs: Treated wood stairs. Never catch fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_slab: A treated wood slab. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_fence: A treated wood fence. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_fence_gate: A treated wood fence gate. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_door: A treated wood door. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_trapdoor: A treated wood trapdoor. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_pressure_p: A treated wood pressure plate. Never catches fire.
tooltip.arcforge.info.treated_button: A treated wood button. Never catches fire.
